
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/zhaoweiwei/p/23483108/mineru" title="发布于 2026-11-10 17:13">
    

    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">MinerU 4.0.12 实战笔记：从PDF到可用的Markdown</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                    <div id="cnblogs_post_description" style="display: none">
        
        MinerU 是 OpenDataLab 开源的文档解析工具，能把 PDF、Office 文档和图片转成 Markdown 与结构化 JSON，本文结合实际使用经验总结了易错踩坑点及其后台API服务的使用方法，最后介绍了mineru解析输出文件相关内容。
    </div>
<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p>我用MinerU 4.0.12在一台Rocky 8.10的老服务器上跑了几个月的试卷和杂志解析。MinerU是OpenDataLab开源的文档解析工具，能把 PDF、Office文档和图片转成Markdown与结构化JSON。网上能搜到的教程大多还停留在3.x，命令和输出格式都变了，照着敲会踩一串坑。这篇把真正影响使用的部分整理出来：怎么装、选哪档、图和JSON在哪、API怎么调、以及几个不会自愈的运维问题。</p>
<h1>1 环境准备</h1>
<h2>1.1 安装</h2>
<p>新机器上按官方文档 pip install "mineru[full]"就行。麻烦出在老系统：4.x 依赖里有一条硬依赖 mineru-llama-cpp，而它在 PyPI 上wheel——需要 glibc ≥ 2.34，本机系统有点老GNU C标准库版本是glibc 2.28，而这个库又是底层库不能随意升级，所以直接pip install mineru注定会失败。首先给出系统软硬件环境：</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/465567/202610/465567-20261029161011148-1389661577.png" alt="image" width="854" height="583" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto"></p>
<p>操作系统是Rocky 8.10，显卡是NVIDIA 12G RTX 4070，MinerU的VLM 推理支持四个引擎：llama.cpp、vLLM、LMDeploy、MLX，llama.cpp安装受限，LMDeploy适用于Windows，而MLX是Apple自家的东西，一般在Mac上使用，所以这里使用Linux + CUDA + vLLM，之后使用如下命令进行安装：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>pip <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">install</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">mineru==4.0.12</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> --no-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">deps
pip </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">install</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">docvortex&gt;=0.5.16,&lt;1</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">          # 必须单独装，且必须和 mineru 成对
pip </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">install</span> &lt;pyproject 里的依赖清单，剔除 mineru-llama-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">cpp</span>&gt;</pre>
</div>
<p>如还遇到问题可以借助AI进行处理。</p>
<h2>1.2 模型下载</h2>
<p>mineru安装完成以后，可以运行如下命令进行pdf解析：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">conda activate mineru4

mineru server start
mineru config set parse_server.local.mode managed   # 只需设一次
mineru server status

MINERU_MODEL_SOURCE</span>=local MINERU_MODEL_SMALL_BACKEND=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">onnx mineru parse doc.pdf </span>--pages all --tier standard -o out/doc.md</pre>
</div>
<p>MINERU_MODEL_SMALL_BACKEND=onnx在我这台机器上是必须的，默认的auto会选torch分支，而torch版布局模型在模块顶层内容如下：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre># mineru/model/layout/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">pp_doclayoutv2.py
from transformers import PPDocLayoutV2Config, PPDocLayoutV2ForObjectDetection</span></pre>
</div>
<p>这两个类在我的transformers 4.57.6中根本不存在，应该是在transformers&gt;=5.10.1后才引进的，但是升级transformers又会影响vLLM依赖链中的xgrammar，所以这里强制走onnx，使用的是pp_doclayout_v2_onnx.py用onnxruntime推理。</p>
<p>首次运行mineru时会进行模型下载，4.x的模型默认下载到~/.mineru/models/目录下：</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/465567/202610/465567-20261029165658329-1873120665.png" alt="image" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto"></p>
<p>MinerU-4_models_onnx：ONNX 小模型（布局、OCR、表格识别），约 0.8GB<br>MinerU-4_models_torch：同一批小模型的Torch实现，约0.85GB<br>MinerU2.5-Pro-2605-1.2B：VLM视觉语言模型（多模态模型），约 2.2GB</p>
<p>运行命令中的--tier参数决定了backend和effort：</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/465567/202610/465567-20261029171607844-319829853.png" alt="image" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto"></p>
<p>basic/standard/advanced共用一套 hybrid 引擎，但high和xhigh是交换，不是叠加：</p>
<p>standard（high）会优先回填PDF文本层里的原生表格，并把这部分从VLM输入里摘出去——表格是它的强项；</p>
<p>advanced（xhigh）放弃了原生表格优先，换来更细的标题层级（doc_title/paragraph_title）和图片内容分析。文本层PDF的表格，advanced可能反而不如standard。</p>
<p>所以结论是：没有通吃的一档，先 flash 探路，表格重的用standard，标题和图片分析重要的用advanced，遇到乱码页换一档再试。</p>
<h1>2 使用详解</h1>
<p>mineru对外提供三种用法，适用不同的使用场景：</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/465567/202610/465567-20261029172915771-1799525977.png" alt="image" width="590" height="195" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto"></p>
<p>可以通过help查看具体用法：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code"><img src="https://images.cnblogs.com/OutliningIndicators/ContractedBlock.gif" id="code_img_closed_2b396f36-4095-4243-bc56-80c5581a4381" class="code_img_closed"><img src="https://images.cnblogs.com/OutliningIndicators/ExpandedBlockStart.gif" id="code_img_opened_2b396f36-4095-4243-bc56-80c5581a4381" class="code_img_opened" style="display: none">

<p>&nbsp;同样可以查看mineru-api、mineru-webui等命令的用法。</p>
<h2>2.1 启动后台服务</h2>
<p>如之前所说mineru-api可以启动后台服务，给别的机器或服务提供api调用接口，所以对此进行详细介绍。处于稳定性考虑，api调用在生产中一般借助系统功能以服务方式启动，具体到linux，可以以system service方式进行管理，如在本机中/etc/systemd/system/mineru-api.service服务单元配置文件内容如下：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code"><img src="https://images.cnblogs.com/OutliningIndicators/ContractedBlock.gif" id="code_img_closed_fc8baa29-b48b-47eb-b22e-0bf414f95c1d" class="code_img_closed"><img src="https://images.cnblogs.com/OutliningIndicators/ExpandedBlockStart.gif" id="code_img_opened_fc8baa29-b48b-47eb-b22e-0bf414f95c1d" class="code_img_opened" style="display: none">
<div id="cnblogs_code_open_fc8baa29-b48b-47eb-b22e-0bf414f95c1d" class="cnblogs_code_hide">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">[Unit]
Description</span>=MinerU Parse API (self-hosted V1, port <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">8010</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
Documentation</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">file</span>:/root/zww/minerU/MinerU-mineru-<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">4.0</span>.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">12</span>-released/docs/en/usage/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">http_api.md
After</span>=network-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">online.target
Wants</span>=network-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">online.target

# vllm 的 EngineCore 会偶发自行 shutdown，之后所有解析任务都报 EngineDeadError，
# 而 </span>/v1/health 仍然返回 <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">200</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">，探活看不出问题。因此不做启动频率限制，
# 保证进程退出后总能被重新拉起。
StartLimitIntervalSec</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

[Service]
Type</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">simple
User</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">root
WorkingDirectory</span>=/root/zww/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">minerU

ExecStart</span>=/usr/local/bin/mineru-log-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">wrapper \
    </span>/root/miniconda3/envs/mineru4/bin/mineru-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">api \
    </span>--host <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0.0</span>.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0.0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> \
    </span>--port <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">8010</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> \
    </span>--<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">tier standard \
    </span>--api-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">key c0ee0b0b036ed005a2e57ae82e1b6d97 \
    </span>--concurrency <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> \
    </span>--allow-http-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">source \
    </span>--preload-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">models

Restart</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">always
RestartSec</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">15</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

# 日志重定向到文件后 Python 会改成块缓冲，崩溃时缓冲区内容会丢失，
# 必须关闭缓冲才能留下 EngineCore 的根因；faulthandler 用于捕获原生崩溃。
Environment</span>=PYTHONUNBUFFERED=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
Environment</span>=PYTHONFAULTHANDLER=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

# 这两个变量是必需的，见 MINERU4_USAGE.md 第二</span>/九节与坑 <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">14</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">：
#   local  只用本地模型，不去连 ModelScope（会被防火墙 policy 拦）
#   onnx   强制 onnx 小模型后端。默认 auto 在 Linux</span>+<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">GPU 上会选 torch 分支，
#          而它需要 transformers</span>&gt;=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">5.10</span>.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>，本环境只有 vllm 带来的 <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">4.57</span>.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">6</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">，
#          漏掉会得到 ImportError: cannot import name </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">PPDocLayoutV2Config</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
Environment</span>=MINERU_MODEL_SOURCE=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">local
Environment</span>=MINERU_MODEL_SMALL_BACKEND=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">onnx

# </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">4.0</span>.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">12</span> 起 ONNX 会话的线程数兜底默认从「交给 ORT 用满物理核」变成 intra=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">4</span>/inter=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">。
# 本机 </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">12</span> 物理核 / <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">24</span> 逻辑核（Ryzen <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">9</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 5900X，无 cgroup 配额），显式设回物理核数，
# 保持 </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">4.0</span>.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span> 的吞吐；--concurrency <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span> 时 12x2=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">24</span>，正好用满 <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">24</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 个逻辑核，不会过度抢占。
Environment</span>=MINERU_INTRA_OP_NUM_THREADS=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">12</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

# </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">4.0</span>.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">12</span> 起 API 产物默认 <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">24</span> 小时后过期（/v1/files/{<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">id</span>} 会 <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">404</span>）。设 <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 关闭回收，
# 保持 </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">4.0</span>.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span> 的语义。若将来想启用，改成秒数即可（如 <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">604800</span> = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">7</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 天）。
Environment</span>=MINERU_API_RETENTION_SECONDS=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

# systemd 单元默认 PATH 不含 conda 环境，vllm 的 torch.compile 需要其中的 ninja，
# 缺了会报 FileNotFoundError: [Errno </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>] No such <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">file</span> or directory: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">ninja</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">，
# 而任务侧只看到误导性的 </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Engine core initialization failed</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">。
Environment</span>=PATH=/root/miniconda3/envs/mineru4/bin:/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">bin

# 系统的 </span>/lib64/libstdc++.so.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">6</span> 只到 GLIBCXX_3.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">4.25</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">，而 flashinfer 预编译的
# sampling.so 需要 GLIBCXX_3.</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">4.26</span>（conda 环境的 libstdc++.so.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">6.0</span>.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">34</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 才有）。
# conda activate 会把它加进 LD_LIBRARY_PATH，systemd 单元必须显式补上。
Environment</span>=LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/root/miniconda3/envs/mineru4/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">lib

# EngineCore 是子进程，必须连它一起收尸，否则残留进程会一直占着 RTX </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">4070</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">。
KillMode</span>=control-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">group
TimeoutStopSec</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">90</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

# 自动创建 </span>/var/log/mineru-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">api
LogsDirectory</span>=mineru-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">api
LogsDirectoryMode</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0755</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

[Install]
WantedBy</span>=multi-user.target</pre>
</div>
<span class="cnblogs_code_collapse">View Code</span></div>
<p>之后运行如下命令创建软链接，使其开机自动启动：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sudo</span> systemctl daemon-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">reload
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sudo</span> systemctl enable mineru-api.service</pre>
</div>
<p>可以使用如下命令启动、停止服务，检查服务运行状态，实时查看服务运行日志：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sudo</span> systemctl start mineru-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">api.service
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sudo</span> systemctl stop mineru-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">api.service
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sudo</span> systemctl status mineru-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">api.service
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sudo</span> journalctl -u mineru-api.service -f</pre>
</div>
<h2>2.2 API调试</h2>
<p>服务启动后可通过ip及绑定的端口查看FastAPI服务的api接口：</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/465567/202610/465567-20261030103821096-326836138.png" alt="image" width="1102" height="619" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto"></p>
<p>可以通过命令：curl http://10.10.1.11:8010/v1/health查看接口是否正常工作，总的来说主要功能接口分为四类：</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/465567/202611/465567-20261102155936459-404382963.png" alt="image" width="908" height="263" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto"></p>
<p>下面结合Apifox工具来对接口进行说明，首先通过URL导入项目：</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/465567/202610/465567-20261030105754670-992794821.png" alt="image" width="672" height="617" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto"></p>
<p>导入项目后即可看到和web页面相同的API接口：</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/465567/202610/465567-20261030110004776-1503123819.png" alt="image" width="565" height="527" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto"></p>
<p>接下来可以直接测试/v1/models接口：</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/465567/202610/465567-20261030110523064-1348165367.png" alt="image" width="1164" height="444" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto"></p>

<p>另外有些接口需要鉴权认证，需提供bearToken，这时候需要“管理环境”增加相应的环境变量bearToken，其值要好启动mineru-api时的--api-key保持一致：</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/465567/202610/465567-20261030111403160-359223546.png" alt="image" width="844" height="719" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto"></p>
<h2>2.3 接口调用示例</h2>
<p>让AI给写了一个完整的API调用示例程序：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code"><img src="https://images.cnblogs.com/OutliningIndicators/ContractedBlock.gif" id="code_img_closed_c1806afa-6e40-41b6-9f53-64d5cbd8cfe5" class="code_img_closed"><img src="https://images.cnblogs.com/OutliningIndicators/ExpandedBlockStart.gif" id="code_img_opened_c1806afa-6e40-41b6-9f53-64d5cbd8cfe5" class="code_img_opened" style="display: none">

<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">!/usr/bin/env python3</span>

    python mineru_api_examples.py uploads  doc.pdf   # 标准链路: /v1/uploads -&gt; /v1/parse/jobs -&gt; /v1/files
    python mineru_api_examples.py tasks    doc.pdf   # 便捷异步: /v1/tasks -&gt; /v1/tasks/{id}/result
    python mineru_api_examples.py sync     doc.pdf   # 同步包装: /v1/file_parse

环境变量:
    MINERU_API_URL  服务地址，默认 http://127.0.0.1:8010
    MINERU_API_KEY  API key；未设置时读取 /root/zww/minerU/.mineru_api_key

依赖: requests (pip install requests)
</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span>

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span> load_api_key() -&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> str:
    key </span>= os.environ.get(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">MINERU_API_KEY</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">""</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">).strip()
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> key:
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> key
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> DEFAULT_KEY_FILE.is_file():
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> DEFAULT_KEY_FILE.read_text(encoding=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">utf-8</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">).strip()
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">""</span>


<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Client:
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">所有请求都显式带上 Bearer Token；上传/下载的跨源场景单独处理。</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">__init__</span>(self, base_url: str, api_key: str) -&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> None:
        self.base_url </span>= base_url.rstrip(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        self.api_key </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> api_key
        self.session </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> requests.Session()

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span> headers(self, extra: dict[str, str] | None = None) -&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> dict[str, str]:
        headers </span>= {<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Authorization</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Bearer {self.api_key}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>} <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> self.api_key <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {}
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> extra:
            headers.update(extra)
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> headers

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span> call(self, method: str, path: str, *, headers: dict[str, str] | None = None, **kwargs) -&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> requests.Response:
        response </span>= self.session.request(method, f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">{self.base_url}{path}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, headers=self.headers(headers), **<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">kwargs)
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> response.status_code &gt;= 400<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">raise</span> RuntimeError(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">{method} {path} -&gt; {response.status_code}: {response.text[:500]}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> response

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span> poll(self, path: str, *, timeout: float = 600.0, interval: float = 1.0) -&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> dict:
        deadline </span>= time.monotonic() +<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> timeout
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">while</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> True:
            payload </span>= self.call(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">GET</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, path).json()
            status </span>= payload.get(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">status</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">  状态: {status}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> status <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> TERMINAL_STATUSES:
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> payload
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> time.monotonic() &gt;=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> deadline:
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">raise</span> TimeoutError(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">{path} 在 {timeout:.0f}s 内没有进入终态 (最后状态 {status})</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
            time.sleep(interval)

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span> download(self, file_id: str) -&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> bytes:
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">下载产物；遇到 302 时不把 API key 带给另一个源。</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        response </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> self.session.get(
            f</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">{self.base_url}/v1/files/{file_id}/content</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, headers=self.headers(), allow_redirects=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">False
        )
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> response.is_redirect:
            response </span>= requests.get(response.headers[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Location</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>], timeout=300<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> response.status_code &gt;= 400<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">raise</span> RuntimeError(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">GET /v1/files/{file_id}/content -&gt; {response.status_code}: {response.text[:300]}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> response.content


</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span> same_origin(url: str, base_url: str) -&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> bool:
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">方案 + 主机 + 有效端口都一致才算同源，同主机不同端口也算跨源。</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span> origin(value: str) -&gt; tuple[str, str |<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> None, int]:
        parsed </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> urlparse(value)
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> parsed.scheme, parsed.hostname, parsed.port <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">or</span> (443 <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> parsed.scheme == <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">https</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span> 80<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> origin(url) ==<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> origin(base_url)


</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span> save_job_outputs(client: Client, files: list[dict], out_dir: Path) -&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> list[Path]:
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Job / task 响应里的 files[] 形状一致：name + status + output_files。</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    out_dir.mkdir(parents</span>=True, exist_ok=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">True)
    saved: list[Path] </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> []
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> entry <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> files:
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> entry.get(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">status</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>) != <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">completed</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">  跳过 {entry.get('name')}: {entry.get('status')} {entry.get('error')}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">continue</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        stem </span>= Path(entry[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">name</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">]).stem
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> fmt, ref <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span> (entry.get(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">output_files</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>) <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">or</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {}).items():
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">not</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ref:
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">continue</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
            target </span>= out_dir / f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">{stem}{OUTPUT_SUFFIX.get(fmt, '.' + fmt)}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
            target.write_bytes(client.download(ref[</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">file_id</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">]))
            saved.append(target)
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">  保存 {target} ({target.stat().st_size} 字节)</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> saved


</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span> save_task_content(payload: dict, out_dir: Path) -&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> list[Path]:
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">/v1/tasks/{id}/result 与 /v1/file_parse 返回的内联结果。</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    out_dir.mkdir(parents</span>=True, exist_ok=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">True)
    saved: list[Path] </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> []
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> entry <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span> payload.get(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">files</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, []):
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> entry.get(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">status</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>) != <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">completed</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">  跳过 {entry.get('name')}: {entry.get('status')} {entry.get('error')}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">continue</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        stem </span>= Path(entry[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">name</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">]).stem
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> fmt, content <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span> (entry.get(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">content</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>) <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">or</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {}).items():
            target </span>= out_dir / f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">{stem}{OUTPUT_SUFFIX.get(fmt, '.' + fmt)}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>
            <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> isinstance(content, str):
                target.write_text(content, encoding</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">utf-8</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
                target.write_text(json.dumps(content, ensure_ascii</span>=False, indent=2), encoding=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">utf-8</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
            saved.append(target)
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">  保存 {target} ({target.stat().st_size} 字节)</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> saved


</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> ── 示例一：/v1/uploads + /v1/parse/jobs（标准链路）────────────────────</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> example_uploads_then_jobs(
    client: Client, pdf: Path, out_dir: Path, </span>*<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, tier: str, ocr_mode: str, formats: list[str]
) </span>-&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> None:
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">上传字节 -&gt; 拿到 file_id -&gt; 提交 Job -&gt; 轮询 -&gt; 从 /v1/files 下载产物。</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    data </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> pdf.read_bytes()
    sha256 </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 1) 创建上传会话。带 sha256sum 时，服务端已有相同字节会直接返回 completed（秒传）。</span>
    upload =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> client.call(
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">POST</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">/v1/uploads</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
        json</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">{
            </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">filename</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: pdf.name,
            </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">bytes</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: len(data),
            </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">mime_type</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">application/pdf</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
            </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">purpose</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">parse</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
            </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">sha256sum</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: sha256,
        },
    ).json()
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">1. upload {upload['id']} status={upload['status']}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> upload[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">status</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>] == <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">pending</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
        upload_url </span>= urljoin(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">{client.base_url}/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, upload[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">upload_url</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">])
        upload_headers </span>= dict(upload.get(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">upload_headers</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>) <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">or</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {})
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> same_origin(upload_url, client.base_url):
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 本地服务的上传地址同源，需要带 API key；云端的预签名 URL 是跨源，不能带。</span>
            upload_headers =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> client.headers(upload_headers)
        response </span>= client.session.put(upload_url, data=data, headers=upload_headers, timeout=300<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> response.status_code &gt;= 400<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">raise</span> RuntimeError(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">PUT {upload_url} -&gt; {response.status_code}: {response.text[:300]}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">2. PUT bytes {len(data)}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 3) complete 生成 File 对象。</span>
        upload =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> client.call(
            </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">POST</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">/v1/uploads/{upload['id']}/complete</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, json={<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">sha256sum</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: sha256}
        ).json()
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">3. complete status={upload['status']}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)

    file_id </span>= upload[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">file</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>][<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">id</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">]
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">   file_id={file_id}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 4) 提交解析任务：POST /v1/parse/jobs 永远返回 202，不会同步等结果。</span>
    job =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> client.call(
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">POST</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">/v1/parse/jobs</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
        json</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">{
            </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">files</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: [{<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">source</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: {<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">type</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">file_id</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">file_id</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: file_id}}],
            </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">tier</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: tier,
            </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">ocr_mode</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: ocr_mode,
            </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">output_formats</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: formats,
        },
    ).json()
    job_id </span>= job[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">job_id</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">]
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">4. job {job_id} status={job['status']}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 5) 轮询到终态。completed / partial / failed / canceled 都是终态。</span>
    job = client.poll(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">/v1/parse/jobs/{job_id}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">5. job 结束: {job['status']}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 6) 产物只给 file_id，内容必须从 /v1/files/{file_id}/content 取。</span>
    save_job_outputs(client, job.get(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">files</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, []), out_dir)

    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">zip</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> formats:

        target </span>= out_dir / f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">{pdf.stem}{OUTPUT_SUFFIX['zip']}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> example_file_parse(
    client: Client, pdf: Path, out_dir: Path, </span>*, tier: str, ocr_mode: str, formats: list[str], wait_timeout: int = 600<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

    params: list[tuple[str, str]] </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> [
        (</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">tier</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, tier),
        (</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">ocr_mode</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, ocr_mode),
        (</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">response_format</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, response_format),
        (</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">wait_timeout</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, str(wait_timeout)),
    ]
    params </span>+= [(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">output_formats</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, fmt) <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> fmt <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> formats]

        f</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">{client.base_url}/v1/file_parse</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, params=params, files=form, headers=client.headers(), timeout=wait_timeout + 60<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    )
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> response.status_code == 202<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
        task </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> response.json()
        task_id </span>= task[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">task_id</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">]
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">1. 等待超时，任务仍在跑: {task_id}，转为轮询</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        client.poll(f</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">/v1/tasks/{task_id}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        response </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> client.session.get(
            f</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">{client.base_url}/v1/tasks/{task_id}/result</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
            params</span>={<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">response_format</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: response_format},

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> response.status_code &gt;= 400<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">1. 同步返回: {response.status_code}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)

        target </span>= out_dir / f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">{pdf.stem}{OUTPUT_SUFFIX['zip']}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    save_task_content(response.json(), out_dir)

    args </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> parser.parse_args()

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">not</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> args.pdf.is_file():
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">找不到文件: {args.pdf}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, file=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">sys.stderr)
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> 1
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> args.pdf.suffix.lower() != <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">.pdf</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">这个示例只处理 PDF: {args.pdf}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, file=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">sys.stderr)
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> 1<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

    formats </span>= [item.strip() <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> item <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span> args.formats.split(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">,</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>) <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> item.strip()]
    out_dir </span>= args.out <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">or</span> Path.cwd() / f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">{args.pdf.stem}_{args.mode}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    client </span>= Client(os.environ.get(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">MINERU_API_URL</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, DEFAULT_BASE_URL), load_api_key())
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">not</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> client.api_key:
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">提示: 未找到 API key，将按匿名请求发送</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, file=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">sys.stderr)

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">服务 {client.base_url} | 文件 {args.pdf} | tier={args.tier} ocr_mode={args.ocr_mode} formats={formats}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> args.mode == <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">uploads</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
        example_uploads_then_jobs(client, args.pdf, out_dir, tier</span>=args.tier, ocr_mode=args.ocr_mode, formats=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">formats)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">elif</span> args.mode == <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">tasks</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
        example_tasks(client, args.pdf, out_dir, tier</span>=args.tier, ocr_mode=args.ocr_mode, formats=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">formats)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
        example_file_parse(
            client,
            args.pdf,
            out_dir,
            tier</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">args.tier,
            ocr_mode</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">args.ocr_mode,
            formats</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">formats,
            wait_timeout</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">args.wait_timeout,
        )
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">完成，产物目录: {out_dir}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 0


</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">__name__</span> == <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">__main__</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">raise</span> SystemExit(main())</pre>
</div>
<span class="cnblogs_code_collapse">View Code</span></div>
<p>示例中包含三种调用模式，基本上覆盖了所有API接口：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre># A. <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sync</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">：同步包装，一次调用等结果（最省事）
python3 </span>/root/zww/minerU/mineru_api_examples.py <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sync</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> doc.pdf </span>--out out/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sync</span> --<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">tier flash

# B. tasks：异步便捷接口，multipart 直传，结果内联
python3 </span>/root/zww/minerU/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">mineru_api_examples.py tasks doc.pdf </span>--out out/tasks --tier standard --<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">formats markdown,middle_json

# C. uploads：标准链路（uploads → parse</span>/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">jobs → files），支持 sha256 秒传
python3 </span>/root/zww/minerU/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">mineru_api_examples.py uploads doc.pdf </span>--out out/uploads --tier advanced --formats markdown,middle_json,<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">zip</span></pre>
</div>
<p>方案A调用的是/v1/file_parse接口，同步包装共享异步任务，请求中包含超时时间，等待超时不取消后台工作，需要根据接口返回的task_id继续通过接口/v1/tasks/{task_id}异步轮询执行结果，轮询完成后可以通过/v1/tasks/{task_id}/result获取结果，根据status_code来判断是否解析成功，如果成功则下载相应的解析结果。</p>
<p>方案B调用/v1/tasks接口post上传待解析的pdf文件后，没有同步等待过程，直接进入到异步轮询状态，之后过程和方案A类似。</p>
<p>方案C是标准链路，先通过/v1/uploads接口POST上传会话（包括文件名、文件长度等信息），之后通过PUT + complete真正完成文件上传，接下来通过接口/v1/parse/jobs请求对上传的文件进行解析，并通过返回的job_id轮询任务状态，结束后通过/v1/files/{file_id}/content获取并保存解析结果文件。</p>
<p>以方案C为例，通过命令：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>python3 /root/zww/minerU/mineru_api_examples.py uploads 2025_yanqing_gaoyi_wuli.pdf --out out/uploads --tier advanced --formats markdown,middle_json,structured_content,<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">zip</span></pre>
</div>
<p>对pdf文件进行解析，结果保存到out/uploads目录，解析级别是advanced，解析结果要有单独markdown，middle_json和structured_content文件，以及完整的解析结果压缩包，程序执行流程如下：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code"><img src="https://images.cnblogs.com/OutliningIndicators/ContractedBlock.gif" id="code_img_closed_40a03771-0e7b-4ddc-98b8-2e9b1dd7ace9" class="code_img_closed"><img src="https://images.cnblogs.com/OutliningIndicators/ExpandedBlockStart.gif" id="code_img_opened_40a03771-0e7b-4ddc-98b8-2e9b1dd7ace9" class="code_img_opened" style="display: none">

<span class="cnblogs_code_collapse">View Code</span></div>
<p>在步骤1中，接口/v1/uploads给出upload['id']为upload_8fe79e7acb250246200a87eb对上传解析的文件进行追踪，http://127.0.0.1:8010/v1/uploads/upload_8fe79e7acb250246200a87eb/content是服务给出的完整上传路径；步骤2直接使用put向该路径上传文件二进制数据；之后步骤3获取上传状态是已完成；步骤4用POST提交解析请求后，服务端会返回job_id；步骤5通过job_id轮询任务执行状态；步骤6通过file_id依次将请求文件下载到本地保存。</p>
<h2>2.4 解析结果详解</h2>
<p>（1）md文件</p>
<p>&nbsp;markdown格式文件，该文件并非简单的文本堆砌，而是专门针对大语言模型（LLM）训练/微调、知识库（RAG）切片以及高保真渲染深度优化后的结构化文本，其核心特性与内容构成如下：</p>
<p>1. 结构化标题与逻辑阅读顺序 (Reading Order)</p>
<p>多级标题映射：MinerU会基于版面分析模型（LayoutLM / YOLO等）识别字号、粗细和段落层级，自动映射为标准的#、##、###等Markdown 标题。</p>
<p>双栏/多栏与浮动块重排：传统工具直接转文本常出现“左右两栏混读”的错乱，MinerU会在后台按照人类自然阅读逻辑重构段落流，输出到.md时已经是严格的上下自然流式顺序。</p>
<p>2. 数学公式的高精度LaTeX化</p>
<p>这是MinerU的一大核心优势：</p>
<p>行内公式：被识别为文本内嵌的公式格式。</p>
<p>独立块级公式：被转换为居中的公式代码块。</p>
<p>复杂矩阵与符号：通过专门训练的公式识别模型（MFR）直接反编译为精准的LaTeX 语法，完全保留积分、求和、矩阵和上下标，方便 RAG 系统直接向大模型提问公式细节。</p>
<p>3. 表格的高保真重构</p>
<p>HTML Table / Markdown Table格式：对于简单的表格，输出为标准的管道符表格（| col1 | col2 |）；对于包含合并单元格（跨行跨列 colspan/rowspan）的复杂三线表或财报表格，通常会以标准的HTML &lt;table&gt;标签输出，避免出现内容串列或格式崩塌。</p>
<p>表头与表注关联：表格上方通常会附带捕获的表格标题（如Table 1: ...），方便做检索时建立完整的元数据上下文。</p>
<p>4. 图片、插图与图注的规范引用</p>
<p>本地相对路径引用：正文中的插图会保存到同级的 images目录下，在 .md 文件中使用标准的相对路径引用：</p>
<p>![](images/xxxx_hash.jpg)</p>
<p>图注（Figure Caption）绑定：图片下方的图注（如 Figure 2: Workflow of ...）会被紧贴在图片下方作为独立段落输出，便于多模态模型或知识库切片时将“图片与其描述文字”保持在同一个 chunk 内。</p>
<p>5. 杂质剔除与正文净化</p>
<p>自动清洗页眉与页脚：每页重复出现的文档名、作者名、页码（Header &amp; Footer）会在版面分析阶段被标注为边缘噪点并直接丢弃，不会像原生 pdftotext 那样每隔几十行就插进一段“Page 12”、“Journal of AI...”。</p>
<p>断词重连（De-hyphenation）：英文排版中行末经常出现的断字连字符（如differ- 换行 ent），在输出的 .md 中会被自动还原为完整的单词 different，防止切词分词时破坏语义。</p>
<p>（2）middle.json文件</p>
<p>middle.json是MinerU解析管线中的核心骨架文件。如果说.md是最终给人或大模型阅读的“成品”，那_middle.json就是模型推理结束后、格式化拼接成Markdown之前保留的全量版面结构底稿。</p>
<p>它详细记录了每一页的几何坐标、版面分析划分的区块、OCR 识别的原始文本行以及模型对公式和表格的中间解析状态，&nbsp;下图是结构化中间数据JSON文件的全局骨架</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/465567/202611/465567-20261110152135922-1185666237.png" alt="image" width="632" height="651" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto"></p>
<p>1. metadata（元数据）</p>
<p>这部分记录了输入文档的基础属性和处理该文档的工具信息。</p>
<p>2. extensions（模型扩展推断）</p>
<p>记录了本次提取使用的MinerU引擎配置和深度学习版面模型（DocVortex)的具体输出，如果展开pages节点将会看到原始pdf包含的页数及PDF规范中的标准绝对物理长度单位width_pt和height_pt等内容，在本次解析实例中width_pt=595.276，height_pt=841.89，1pt=1/72 inch = 1/72*25.4 mm ≈ 0.3527mm，所以width_pt≈210 mm，height_pt ≈ 297 mm，对应标准 A4 纸的长宽尺寸。</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/465567/202611/465567-20261110155144539-194959592.png" alt="image" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto"></p>
<p>3. pages（物理页面解析详情）</p>
<p>逐页的细粒度内容与结构树（核心数据），这是用于最终渲染Markdown的最关键数组，数组中的每一个元素代表PDF中的一页，每个页面内部展开后包含blocks，对应该页中包含的完整内容块列表，展开后里面就是具体划分出的title（标题）、text（自然段）、table（表格）、image（图片）等。</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/465567/202611/465567-20261110160636371-1186813938.png" alt="image" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto"></p>
<p>每个 block 内部会包含其对应的绝对坐标 bbox: [x0, y0, x1, y1]、以及之后的content信息，构成整篇文档自然阅读顺序的基本单元，其中bbox中的x，y都是根据宽高归一化到0~1内的坐标值。</p>
<p>（3）structured_content.json文件</p>
<p>如果说middle.json是记录所有原始边界坐标、底层版面分割的“生数据工程图”，那么stuctured_context.json文件是经过阅读顺序重排、文本净化、公式反编译和表格规整后的<strong data-path-to-node="1" data-index-in-node="100">高纯度语义结构树</strong>，即后者在前者的基础上进行了智能化处理。</p>
<p>（4）zip文件</p>
<p>&nbsp;包含以上所有3种文件，并且压缩包中还包含images目录，里面是所有的切片插图文件，所以理论上要求zip后就不需要请求其他格式的文件输出。</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h1>参考</h1>
<p>1&nbsp;<a href="https://github.com/opendatalab/MinerU" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/opendatalab/MinerU</a></p>
<p>2&nbsp;<a href="https://wnjson.com/jsonudview" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://wnjson.com/jsonudview</a></p>
